text:
Maya (Sales): handing off Helios Health - signed today. Midmarket, healthcare. Needs: Private deploy w/ VPC peering, SAML (Okta), KMS (customer HSM), dedicated GPUs for embedding-heavy workflows. Go-live target ~7 weeks. Renewal in 11 months; procurement requested price review at month 6 (renewal-risk: medium). Contacts: taylor@helios and samir@helios.

Ola (CS): thanks! I'll lead onboarding. Quick q: BA/hipaa? data residency? expected tokens/month?

Maya (Sales): BA signed. US-only. Token estimate: 40M/mo now, expected 140M/mo in 3 months. Will DM usage sheet.

Rex (Eng): I'll open INF ticket for Private + HSM and add eng-runtime for GPU sizing. Need allowlist CIDRs, latency SLOs, and whether embeddings should be isolated on separate nodes.

June (Support): will prepare PHI runbook and a 30-day elevated support plan. Need peak qps and escalation contacts.

Femi (Enablement): I'll create a 45m admin + ops session and an ops cheat sheet. Request list of staging users and roles.

InfraBot: ticket INF-4902 created by Rex for Helios private deployment.

Ola (CS): owners: Ola = onboarding, Rex = infra, June = support, Femi = enablement. Action list: create CS project, schedule kickoff, exchange SAML metadata, open infra ticket (done), draft runbook, record enablement. I'll post kickoff times after I get their availability.

Rex (Eng): noted. I'll include option for dedicated embedding nodes and quantization suggestions in INF-4902.

June (Support): setting alert thresholds draft: 95th latency >500ms, error rate >1% sustained 5m, embedding backlog >30 jobs. Will share runbook in this thread.

Maya (Sales): sending intro email to execs and copying Ola. tagging finance note for the month-6 pricing review.

Ola (CS): great. I'll update the health dashboard with renewal flag and timeline. Updates posted here after kickoff. :thumbsup:
